column1: Health AI Orchestration · v1.0 · source BRD v1.1 · proposed baseline · 26 September 2026
Controlled design catalogue. Update through the versioned specification review process.

column3: Use a task-centred mobile flow with person and encounter context fixed
column4: Workers reuse facts across programmes; distinct patient records remain isolated
column5: UI widgets and question packs require usability validation

column3: Start with a modular service and database-backed outbox workers
column4: Reduces cross-service failure modes while preserving clear component contracts
column5: Split components only when measured scale or custody requires it

column3: Persist typed operational entities and transform at adapter boundaries
column4: Shared facts retain provenance while destinations keep independent schemas
column5: Canonical shape is not itself an ABDM clinical document

column3: Use an Android reference client with encrypted local storage and keystore wrapping
column4: Offline lease and media recovery require controlled device behaviour
column5: Web admin supports online work; browser storage is not the default clinical offline store

column3: Separate model planning from deterministic execution and policy
column4: Tool outputs and retrieved records cannot grant authority
column5: Model vendor selected through performance privacy and cost review

column3: Use saga-style recovery and evidence-based reconciliation
column4: No global atomic commit exists across unrelated programme systems
column5: Uncertain results need lookup or manual resolution before retry

column3: Use append-only clinical fact revisions and approval hashes
column4: Corrections remain attributable and invalidate affected work
column5: Storage and retention policy must cover original and corrected versions

column3: Activate provider and model version per deployment and scope
column4: Evidence and local permission differ from a successful API test
column5: Substitution requires equivalent approved intended use

column3: Implement ABDM and direct EHR as separate connector types
column4: Consent or API availability does not grant universal records access
column5: Exact external contracts stay blocked until owner verification

column3: Use service policy and tenant RLS with separate runtime roles
column4: Prevents client scope selection and catches tenant query errors
column5: Tenant RLS does not replace patient relationship and purpose checks

column3: Build controlled report projections from versioned domain events
column4: Queries can disclose source completeness and avoid double counting
column5: Late records require reproducible metric revision

column3: Simulators emit mode and source markers and use isolated fixtures
column4: Development can exercise failures before partner credentials exist
column5: Simulation evidence cannot pass live connector or clinical validation gates
